dict.string: EchoVoice reads and writes NFC tags so you can place a tag anywhere in your home and tap it to speak a phrase in your own voice.
EchoVoice uses the front camera to follow your head or eyes so you can choose phrases hands-free. Camera images are processed on this device and are never saved or sent anywhere.

EchoVoice records phrases in your own voice so you can speak them later. In Listen mode it hears your conversation partner so it can suggest replies, and it can measure how loud the room is to adjust speaking volume. Nothing is sent anywhere.

During a voice journal check-in, EchoVoice checks how much of the practice sentence was understood. In Listen mode, it turns what your conversation partner says into text so it can suggest replies. Recognition runs entirely on this device, and audio is never stored or sent anywhere.
